brief:
Footballs have become scarce and expensive commodities in Gaza, Shehab Wire reported. Soccer balls that once cost children and athletes tens of shekels are now selling for hundreds of shekels when available, marking a dramatic shift in access to basic sporting equipment in the territory.

The price spike reflects broader supply constraints affecting Gaza. What was previously an affordable plaything for young people has transformed into a luxury item beyond the reach of most families. The shift underscores how the shortage of goods has reshaped daily life, turning even simple recreational tools into goods reserved for those who can afford steep markups.
